description: Execute implementation tasks from a feature plan in .unikit/plans/. Reads TASKS.md and PLAN-BRIEF.md, then implements uncompleted tasks sequentially executing tasks inline (Read/Edit/Write/Bash) with rules loaded once at start. Supports selective execution by phase or task numbers. Use when the user says "implement", "start coding", "execute plan", "continue implementation", "do the next task", "implement phase 3", or wants to work through a planned feature. Also use when the user references tasks from .unikit/plans/ or asks to "continue where we left off".
